containerautofill.config.comment.enableM: Master switch for every feature of this mod.
containerautofill.config.comment.clickDe:
Ticks between automated inventory clicks.
1 = one click per tick. Raise this on servers with strict anti-cheat.
containerautofill.config.comment.clearWr:
When enabled, items the schematic does not expect in a slot are shift-clicked
into your inventory before filling. Off by default: wrong items are left alone.
containerautofill.config.comment.useTake: While filling, pull missing items out of shulker boxes in your inventory, and out of shulker boxes stored in your linked containers.
containerautofill.config.comment.matchSh:
Treat a shulker box in a container slot as correct when its contents match,
even if its colour or name differs from the schematic.
containerautofill.config.comment.closeAf: Close the container after 'Fill Looked At Container' has finished.
containerautofill.config.comment.shulker:
Pick block (vanilla and Litematica schematic pick block / easy place) pulls the block from a shulker box in
your inventory, or from a linked container (also from shulker boxes stored there), when you don't carry it loose.
containerautofill.config.comment.debugLo: Write detailed fill and retrieval steps to the game log.
containerautofill.config.comment.highlig:
Colour every placed schematic container near you by how it compares with the schematic:
green = correct, blue = empty, yellow = partly filled, red = wrong items, grey = not known.
Contents are read from the server (singleplayer/LAN, Cytra Container on the server); otherwise known after opening
a container once, or live with Servux + Litematica entity data sync.
Only containers within this many blocks are checked and highlighted.
Draw the highlight boxes through other blocks.

Draw a container's box on top when only water or lava is between you and it (e.g. chests at the bottom of a pool).
Walls and other blocks still hide it, unless Highlight Through Walls is on.
Also highlight containers that already match the schematic (green).
Also highlight containers whose contents aren't known yet (grey).
containerautofill.config.comment.colorCo: Highlight colour for containers that match the schematic.
containerautofill.config.comment.colorEm: Highlight colour for empty containers the schematic expects items in.
containerautofill.config.comment.colorPa: Highlight colour for containers missing some expected items.
containerautofill.config.comment.colorWr: Highlight colour for containers holding items the schematic doesn't expect (or too many).
containerautofill.config.comment.colorUn: Highlight colour for containers whose contents aren't known yet.
containerautofill.config.comment.autoFil:
Press while a container screen is open to fill it to match the schematic.
Press again to cancel. Unbound by default.
containerautofill.config.comment.fillLoo: Fills the schematic container under the crosshair. With Instant Fill it isn't opened.
containerautofill.message.wrong_items_ke: %s slot(s) hold items the schematic doesn't expect. Enable 'Clear Wrong Items' to replace them.
containerautofill.message.wrong_items_re: %s slot(s) still hold wrong items (your inventory may be full).
containerautofill.message.inventory_full: Your inventory is full, so some items could not be moved or pulled from shulkers.
containerautofill.message.cancelled_scre: Auto-fill cancelled: the container was closed.
containerautofill.message.cancelled_curs: Auto-fill stopped: no room in your inventory for the item on the cursor.
containerautofill.message.cancelled_too_: Auto-fill stopped: too many actions without finishing.
containerautofill.message.unknown_contai: Can't tell which block this container is. Reopen it by right-clicking the block.
containerautofill.message.not_in_placeme: This container is not part of an active schematic placement
containerautofill.message.schematic_not_: The schematic has no container at this position
containerautofill.message.not_looking_at: Look at a container to fill it
containerautofill.message.stop_sneaking: Stop sneaking to open the container
containerautofill.message.stacked_shulke: Stacked shulker boxes can't be taken from. Split the stack first.
containerautofill.message.takeitout_unsu: This server doesn't accept shulker item requests (TakeItOut is not installed there). Only loose inventory items will be used.
containerautofill.message.restock_empty: Restock: no more %s in your restock shulker boxes
containerautofill.config.comment.restock: Keep hotbar and offhand stacks topped up from shulker boxes whose name contains the Restock Name (e.g. a shulker named "Restock" full of fireworks). Works even with the TakeItOut options or the rest of the mod turned off. Needs singleplayer/LAN or Cytra Container installed on the server. Optional toggle key.
A shulker box counts as a restock box if its name contains this word (not case-sensitive). Rename shulker boxes in an anvil.

A stack is filled back to a full stack once it drops below this many items. For items that stack to 16 (ender pearls, snowballs) at most half a stack is used. A stack whose last item you use is also refilled.
Also restock the offhand (e.g. fireworks for elytra flight).
When a totem of undying in your offhand or hotbar pops, put a new one from a restock box in the same slot straight away.
Use restock shulker boxes carried in your inventory.
Use restock shulker boxes stored in your ender chest (no need to open it).
Show a message when an item you've been restocking runs out in your restock boxes.
containerautofill.config.comment.takeItO:
Switch for the TakeItOut part of the mod. When off, nothing is pulled into your hand: no pulls from shulker boxes or linked containers on pick block or easy place, no Single-item Buffer top-ups and no Hotbar Refill.
Fills, the container highlight, the storage menu and Restock keep working. Optional toggle key.
containerautofill.config.comment.hotbarR: When placing or using the last item in your hand empties the slot, refill it with the same item: from the rest of your inventory, then shulker boxes you carry, then linked containers and the shulker boxes stored in them. Not in creative or while Litematica's easy place is on. Optional toggle key.
containerautofill.config.comment.refillB: When you empty a water (or lava) bucket from your hand, a full one is put back in your hand: from the rest of your inventory, then shulker boxes you carry, then linked containers. The empty bucket goes to another slot. Not in creative or while Litematica's easy place is on.
containerautofill.config.comment.printer: With Litematica Printer installed: when the printer needs a block you don't carry loose, it is fetched from a shulker box in your inventory or a linked container, then printed.
containerautofill.config.comment.singleI: In Single-item Mode, how many items each pull from linked storage takes. While you hold easy place, more are pulled before you run out, so the next blocks are already in your inventory. 1 = strictly one item per pull (slower on servers with high ping).
Pick block and easy place take a few items (Single-item Buffer, default 3) instead of a full stack. Toggle key: B.
containerautofill.config.comment.useLink: Auto-fill, pick block and easy place pull missing items out of your linked containers (any distance, while their chunk is loaded), including from shulker boxes stored in them (needs Cytra Container 1.2.0+ on the server).
containerautofill.config.comment.linkedO: Outline every linked container in the active group (dump containers in their own colour).
Draw linked container outlines through other blocks.
containerautofill.config.comment.openSto: Opens the linked storage menu (All Items, Containers, Groups).
containerautofill.config.comment.linkLoo: Link the container you're looking at to the active group, or unlink it if it is already linked.
containerautofill.config.comment.boxSele: Press on one corner block, then on the opposite corner: adds every container in the box to the group you have selected.
containerautofill.config.comment.markDum: Mark (or unmark) the container you're looking at as a dump target.
containerautofill.config.comment.dumpToC: Move your main inventory (not the hotbar) into your dump containers.
containerautofill.storage.title: Cytra Container - Storage
containerautofill.message.storage_box_fi: First corner set at %s - now mark the opposite corner
containerautofill.message.storage_no_dum: No dump containers in this group - mark some first
containerautofill.message.storage_unsupp: This server doesn't support linked storage (install Cytra Container on the server)
containerautofill.message.storage_look_f: %s is in %s container(s), nearest at %s (marked for 10 s)
containerautofill.message.instant_fill_t: The server didn't answer the fill request
containerautofill.message.instant_fill_u: Part of the container couldn't be filled (not loaded, or locked)
containerautofill.config.comment.areaFil: Blocks around you that the Area Fill key fills.

Instantly fills every placed schematic container within Area Fill Range that isn't already correct,
nearest first, without opening anything. Needs singleplayer/LAN or Cytra Container on the server.
containerautofill.message.area_summary: Filled %s slots in %s containers, %s items missing
containerautofill.message.area_fill_unsu: Area fill needs singleplayer/LAN or Cytra Container installed on the server
containerautofill.message.area_fill_noth: No schematic containers to fill nearby
containerautofill.config.comment.creativ:
In creative mode, fill containers completely with exactly what the schematic expects,
whether or not you have the items anywhere.
containerautofill.storage.shared_groups: Shared on this server (Add puts a copy in your groups)
containerautofill.storage.shared_unsuppo: Shared groups need Cytra Container 1.3.0+ on the server
containerautofill.storage.shared_none: Nothing shared yet. Press Share on one of your groups.
containerautofill.message.shared: Shared group %s (%s containers) with everyone on this server
containerautofill.message.shared_unsuppo: Sharing needs Cytra Container 1.3.0+ on the server
containerautofill.message.shared_limit: You can share up to %s groups; remove one first
containerautofill.message.easy_place_inv: Can't fetch %s: your inventory is full and has no block to swap into the shulker box
containerautofill.message.easy_place_uns: Can't fetch %s from shulker boxes: the server doesn't run Cytra Container (or TakeItOut)
containerautofill.message.easy_place_bus: Still fetching another item; try %s again in a moment
containerautofill.message.easy_place_not: No %s in your inventory, shulker boxes or linked containers
containerautofill.message.easy_place_no_: No hotbar slot to put %s in (Litematica's Pick Blockable Slots)
containerautofill.config.comment.pullMat: Move everything Litematica's open material list still needs (minus what you carry) from your linked containers into the shulker boxes in your inventory. Open the material list for your placement in Litematica first. Also a button in the storage menu.
containerautofill.message.materials_unsu: Get Materials needs Cytra Container 1.3.6+ on the server
containerautofill.message.materials_no_l: Open the material list for your placement in Litematica first
containerautofill.message.materials_noth: You already carry everything %s still needs
containerautofill.message.materials_pull: Getting %s kinds of materials from linked containers...
containerautofill.message.materials_no_b: No shulker boxes in your inventory to put the materials in
containerautofill.message.materials_done: Moved %s items into your shulker boxes; %s kinds (%s items) still missing
containerautofill.message.materials_boxe: Your shulker boxes are full; bring more empty ones for the rest
